forecast.rationale: Base rates for discretionary second-home satisfaction at >1x income are poor; usage projections of 20 weekends/yr typically realize at 8-12; the 60% rental offset assumes 8 rented weeks that compete with the 20 family weekends. The down payment being available without touching retirement is the strongest point in favor, but the single-income exposure cuts the other way.
clarifying_questions: Is the 20-weekend estimate the parents' or the whole family's?
